title: senecio crassiflorus
intro: Senecio crassiflorus, commonly known as Yellow Bells or Jacob's Ladder, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio crassiflorus include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate pain, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant and immunomodulator. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
